messages:
maria: Quick pass please — need to finalize Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy before the launch email. Focus: one-liners, hero CTAs, and inbound-routing (webinar vs demo vs contact sales).
ajay: For Hosted I'd lead with "Fastest way to ship LLM features" — PLG folks resonate with speed + simple pricing. CTA -> 'Start free' / routing to self-serve signup.
leigh: Agree on Hosted. For Dedicated highlight 'predictable throughput' and 'SLA-backed' in the hero. CTA -> 'Book capacity review' (route to AE).
tom: Small flag: any performance/latency claims need infra sign-off. We can't say "sub-10ms" unless bench exists. Keep phrasing "low-latency" for now.
kate: Visual idea — three-column hero showing Hosted / Dedicated / Private, each with small benefit bullets and primary CTA. For Private, use trust cues (lock icon + KMS/HSM).
maria: Good call. Draft hero copy ideas: Hosted: "Ship LLM features fast — hosted API with streaming, function calling, and transparent pricing." Dedicated: "Predictable throughput, reserved GPU pools, SLA-backed latency." Private: "Private control plane and on‑prem options for regulated workloads." Thoughts?
ajay: Thumbs up. For messaging tests: run 2 headline variants per page — one benefits-first, one ROI-first. Measure signups and demo requests.
leigh: Routing rules suggestion: Hosted -> self-serve signup + 'Request webinar' event. Dedicated -> AE routing if user selects "Reserved capacity" or company size > 200. Private -> AE + Security contact if they check "compliance/air‑gapped".
copybot: Suggested short CTAs for each: Hosted: "Start free"; Dedicated: "Request capacity"; Private: "Talk to sales". Also recommend adding microcopy under CTAs for expected response time (e.g., "AE response within 48 hours").
tom: For inbound form, add hidden field 'customer_tier' and event hooks:
```
// GA event
track('lead', { tier: 'dedicated', product: 'redwood-inference' })
```
Make sure privacy team signs off on data capture.
kate: We should A/B test hero image vs no-image to reduce cognitive load. Also use a small benchmark callout for Hosted: "Verified throughput on NVIDIA A100" — but legal & infra need to approve exact wording.
maria: Action items: 1) copy team to finalize two headline variants by EOD Wed (ajay + leigh) 2) product to confirm allowable perf language (tom) 3) design to mock 3-column hero + mobile (kate) 4) growth to set routing rules for forms and AB test events (ajay) 5) create webinar landing anchor on Hosted page (maria).
ajay: I'll set up AB experiments and the event plumbing. Need demo script for webinar; anyone owning?
leigh: I'll draft webinar outline (technical deep dive + customer latency/cost case studies).
maria: Thanks all — ping me on threads if blockers. :thumbsup:
